# audit-minute-cursor

rows is an array already sorted ascending by the numeric pair (minute, entryId); each pair is unique and both fields are nonnegative safe integers. timelinePage(rows, cursor, limit) returns {items, nextCursor}. A null cursor starts at the beginning; otherwise select pairs strictly greater than the cursor pair, comparing minute first and entryId on equal minutes. The cursor row need not still exist. limit is a positive integer. items contains at most limit rows in original order. If more rows remain after items, nextCursor is the last returned pair; otherwise it is null. Do not mutate inputs.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Keep the public API and tests/ unchanged. Use Node built-ins only; no packages or network.
